items.title: 许可证已生效：自 v1.8.1 起改为 AGPL-3.0（此前为 MIT）
items.body: 自 v1.8.1 起本仓库整体采用 AGPL-3.0；v1.8.0 及更早版本维持 MIT。日常使用、自部署不受影响；任何二次利用（含网络服务形式）需同协议开源。
items.titleEn: License in effect: AGPL-3.0 starting with v1.8.1 (previously MIT)
items.bodyEn: The repository ships under AGPL-3.0 since v1.8.1; releases up to v1.8.0 remain MIT. Everyday use and self-hosting are unaffected; any reuse — including as a network service — must stay under the same license.

items.title: Qoder 排队机制与账号风控说明
items.body: 部分 Qoder 账号持续排队（10605）是官方账号级风控慢速队列；订阅套餐有专属优先通道。10Router 自动识别并冷却顺延至其他可用账号。
items.titleEn: Qoder queue throttle and account rate-limit explained
items.bodyEn: Continuous queueing on some Qoder accounts (10605) is the official per-account slow lane; subscribed plans get a priority lane. 10Router detects it and fails over automatically.

items.title: 「余额优先」修好了：此前设过不生效的，现在会真的生效
items.body: 详情页的「小额优先 / 大额优先」以前会把选择丢掉（整张策略表被页面快照整体写回），还会被全局「轮询」压过——现在已生效，运行日志会记一行选中结果可直接核对。另外余额为 0 或已透支的号不再被「小额优先」顶到最前，改为沉到队尾；QuWork、DuMate、灵犀、DeepAI、AutoClaw 双端、Clixad、FreePi 七家的详情页新出现这个入口。
items.titleEn: Balance-first scheduling is fixed — what you set before now actually applies
items.bodyEn: "Lowest / highest balance first" used to be lost on save (the whole strategy table was rewritten from a page snapshot) and could be overridden by a global round-robin; it now sticks and logs the chosen account so you can verify it. Accounts at zero or negative balance no longer lead the queue on lowest-first — they sink to the back. Seven providers gained the entry: QuWork, DuMate, Lingxi, DeepAI, AutoClaw (both lines), Clixad, FreePi.

items.title: 组合：排前渠道假死秒级让位，轮询按时间窗粘滞
items.body: 组合排前的成员若上游只挂连接不回应，以前最坏干等约 249 秒才换下一个（客户端自己的超时先到，看起来像整个组合卡死）；现在改用专门的短探测预算（默认 12 秒，环境变量 COMBO_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS 可调），连续两次全无应答的成员临时往后垫、但不会被踢出轮换。轮询策略同时改为活跃时段固定同一个模型、空闲超过窗口（默认 5 分钟，设置页可调，也可改回按请求数切换）才轮换。
items.titleEn: Combos: a dead channel yields in seconds, rotation sticks within a time window
items.bodyEn: A leading combo member that only holds the socket used to cost up to ~249s before the next one got a turn — your client timed out first and the whole combo looked frozen. A dedicated probe budget (12s by default, COMBO_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS) handles it now, and a member with two back-to-back no-answers is temporarily pushed back rather than dropped from rotation. Round-robin also keeps the same model while traffic is active and only rotates once idle passes the window (5 minutes, configurable, or switch back to per-request).

items.title: 四条免费车道：Junie Lite / AtomCode / Clixad / FreePi
items.body: Junie（JetBrains）免费账号即可用 Junie Lite 车道；AtomCode 登录时自动领 Lite 体验版（每 5 小时 300 次请求）；Clixad 每日 12 万 credits、8 款免费模型；FreePi 每日 4000 credits（广告位买单）。四家都带额度卡。须知：这是各家客户端自己的接口，上游策略变更可能失效或触发风控，请自担账号风险，且只用自己的账号登录。
items.titleEn: Four free lanes: Junie Lite / AtomCode / Clixad / FreePi
items.bodyEn: Junie's free lane opens to any JetBrains account; AtomCode auto-claims a Lite trial on sign-in (300 requests per 5 hours); Clixad grants 120k credits a day across 8 free models; FreePi grants 4k (an ad slot pays for it). All four ship a quota card. Notice: these are the clients' own endpoints — upstream policy changes can break them or trip risk control, so weigh the account risk and sign in with your own account only.

items.title: Qoder 双端可用 HungerG（0x 免费）；CodeBuddy 限免临近截止
items.body: 官方那个 0x 的 HungerG（1M 上下文、可读图）此前只在桌面客户端目录里出现，现在 Qoder 国内版与国际版都能选，国际版同时补上 Fast（0.6x）；GLM-5.4 也上了 Qoder、CodeBuddy CN、千问办公国内版与 ZCode 免费线。CodeBuddy CN 的 Hy4 flash 限免按官方标注只到 11 月底，到期后徽章自动回落原价——趁现在用。已建的连接无需重新登录，刷新模型列表即可看到。
items.titleEn: HungerG (0x) opens on both Qoder lines; a CodeBuddy promo is about to close
items.bodyEn: The official 0x HungerG (1M context, vision) used to appear only in the desktop app's catalog — it is selectable on Qoder CN and intl now, with Fast (0.6x) added to intl; GLM-5.4 also landed on Qoder, CodeBuddy CN, QwenWork CN and the ZCode free line. CodeBuddy CN's Hy4 flash free promo runs only to the end of November per the official note, after which the badge falls back to its real rate on its own. Existing connections need no re-login — refresh the model list.

items.title: 四家扫码 / 签到型供应商：QuWork、商汤小浣熊、OrcaTerm、AutoClaw
items.body: QuWork（+86 短信登录、积分卡、每日签到、微信绑定与兑换码激活）、商汤小浣熊（微信扫码，积分按任务和邀请自动发）、OrcaTerm（腾讯云终端微信扫码，支持工具调用与读图）、AutoClaw 国内 / 国际版（智谱澳龙，GLM-5.3 Flash 免费 + 可选自动签到）。两点需要行动：QuWork 网关拒绝非中国大陆 IP（HTTP 405），服务器在海外请给该连接配国内代理；AutoClaw 走逆向桌面端接口，10Router 使用期间勿让桌面端同登同一账号。
items.titleEn: Four QR / check-in providers: QuWork, Raccoon, OrcaTerm, AutoClaw
items.bodyEn: QuWork (+86 SMS, credit ledger, daily check-in, WeChat binding and code redemption), SenseNova Raccoon (WeChat QR, credits auto-granted by tasks and invites), OrcaTerm (Tencent Cloud terminal, WeChat QR, tools and vision supported) and AutoClaw CN / intl (Zhipu, GLM-5.3 Flash free, optional auto check-in). Two things need action: QuWork rejects non-mainland-China IPs (HTTP 405), so give that connection a mainland proxy when the server is overseas; AutoClaw rides a reverse-engineered desktop API — don't keep the desktop app signed into the same account while 10Router uses it.

items.title: Amazon Quick：没有 API Key，粘一段 Copy as cURL 即用
items.body: AWS 的办公 agent（Q Business 的后继）没有公开 chat API，调用走你已登录的 quick.aws.com 浏览器会话：在网页聊天里发一句话，F12 找一条 ws-rpc 请求右键 Copy as cURL，整段粘进连接框即可。模型是 fast / smart / advanced 三档，消耗套餐的月度 agent 小时。会话不能自动续期，测试变红就是过期了，重贴一段即可。
items.titleEn: Amazon Quick: no API key — paste one Copy as cURL and go
items.bodyEn: AWS's workplace agent (successor to Q Business) has no public chat API, so calls ride your signed-in quick.aws.com browser session: send one message in the web chat, find a ws-rpc request in DevTools, right-click → Copy as cURL, paste the whole thing into the connection box. Three tiers (fast / smart / advanced), billed against your plan's monthly agent hours. The session can't be refreshed — a red connection test means it expired, so paste a fresh one.

items.title: Numes 与 Atlas Cloud：两个 OpenAI 兼容网关，Numes 带 :free 与 BTC 余额
items.body: Numes 是多家独立供应商的推理市场，余额可选美元或比特币（创建 Key 时固定币种），模型 ID 与 OpenRouter 同形态，带 :free 后缀的完全免费（GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3.1 Pro 等），已预置 34 款主力模型、其余填 ID 即用。Atlas Cloud 是纯 API Key 接入的兼容网关。
items.titleEn: Numes and Atlas Cloud: two OpenAI-compatible gateways, Numes with :free and a BTC balance
items.bodyEn: Numes is an inference marketplace routed across independent providers — balance in USD or bitcoin (fixed when the key is created), OpenRouter-shaped model ids, and a :free suffix that costs nothing (GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro and friends); 34 models are preloaded and the rest work by id. Atlas Cloud is a plain API-key gateway.

items.title: Trae 免费账号实际只有豆包可用；本轮清单数值未经 live 验证
items.body: Trae 国际线按官方客户端重排了清单，除 Auto Mode 与豆包 Seed-2.1-Turbo 外全部带锁（需 Lite / Pro / Pro+ / Ultra），徽章现在如实反映免费账号的真实可达面；国内版新增三行带锁模型，并改正 DeepSeek 倍率与闲时口径（空闲时段=北京时间每日 22:00–次日 8:00）。注意：Trae 没有可读的模型目录接口，本轮数值来自官方客户端截图，未经 live 验证。
items.titleEn: On a free Trae account only Doubao is reachable; this catalog round isn't live-verified
items.bodyEn: Trae intl's list now follows the official client, with everything locked except Auto Mode and Doubao Seed-2.1-Turbo (Lite / Pro / Pro+ / Ultra) — the badges finally show what a free account can actually reach. The CN line gained three locked rows and corrected its DeepSeek rates plus the off-peak window (22:00–08:00 Beijing time). Caveat: Trae exposes no readable model catalog, so these figures come from client screenshots and are not live-verified.
